snippet.title: Monsterhearts: Welcome to Drowned Lake Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the picturesque town of Drowned Lake. Former mining town, current destination for tourists looking to experience small-town Canada. From swaying pines to placid waters, it's hard to imagine anything happening here. But looks can be deceiving, and beneath still waters secrets run deep. Most residents are content not to look below the surface. Others, well... others don't get that choice.

Based on the popular Monsterhearts roleplaying game by Avery Alder, Monsterhearts: Welcome to Drowned Lake is a standalone adventure set in northern British Columbia, where the residents are not always what they seem, and conceal deep secrets. Unravel the mysteries of this seemingly sleepy town while navigating the challenges of surviving high school as a teenage monster, and discover not only what lies beneath the peaceful veneer of Drowned Lake, but what dark secrets stir within you.

Join our Discord community at discord.gg/wvDSNMTt for announcements, news, and sneak peeks as Monsterhearts: Welcome to Drowned Lake develops.

And check out our Kickstarter page, which launches October 1st! kickstarter.com/projects/ludiclemur/monsterhearts-welcome-to-drowned-lake
